_comment: Copy to echo_location.json and fill in YOUR home gateway MAC. The real file is gitignored (it's your home-network fingerprint). Detection off or missing file => location resolves to 'unknown' (neutral/home-style). The voice override ('Echo, we're in the Jeep') always works regardless.
_find_gateway_mac: PowerShell: $g=(Get-NetRoute -DestinationPrefix '0.0.0.0/0' | Sort-Object RouteMetric | Select -First 1).NextHop; Get-NetNeighbor -IPAddress $g | Select LinkLayerAddress
